warnings: *** PAGE OFFSET FOR THIS WHOLE HOUSE: PNG = printed page + 2. *** หน้า01 is the cover and หน้า02 is this contents page, neither of which carries a printed page number; printed page 1 is PNG 03. VERIFIED by opening PNG 34 and finding S-01 with the printed page number 32 in its footer, exactly as this index states. Every maps_to_png value in this file is derived with that +2 offset -- it is NOT printed on the sheet.
68 drawing sheets in five disciplines (A-01..A-31, S-01..S-17, SN-01..SN-10, EE-01..EE-06, M-01..M-04), then two parallel BOQ sets and a planning-regulations appendix. 108 PNG pages in total.

TWO PARALLEL BOQ SETS, exactly as in houses 04 and 05: one costed for spread footings (printed 69, PNG 71) and one for pile footings (printed 86, PNG 88). They are alternative pricings of the same building, not sequential parts -- do not merge them.

This house belongs to a DIFFERENT SERIES from house 06: 'แบบบ้านสานฝัน ของขวัญปีใหม่' (2562/2019) rather than 'ไทยช่วยไทย' (2546/2003). Different drawing-number format (S 62047), different sheet-code scheme (EE not E, M present), and a universal-design brief (บ้านอารยสถาปัตย์ -- accessible housing for the elderly and disabled).
